body:
Vicoustic’s Pulsar Panel offers an easy-to-install and cost-effective solution for any kind of room requiring acoustic absorption treatment. This panel has excellent absorption capabilities and provides an effective amount of diffusion.

Suitable for use in both small and large spaces, Pulsar Panels can either be used in a pattern, or as single units.

Applications:

Listening Rooms, Home Theaters, Recording and Broadcast Studios, Post Production Studios, Performance Spaces, Rehearsal Rooms, Conference and Teleconference Rooms, Public Spaces, Auditoriums, etc.
